title: Adaptive signal-classifier and SLA-aware routing for enterprise security/compliance asks
creator: Ava Kline
description: Build an automated signal-classifier and SLA-aware routing layer for incoming enterprise security and compliance requests (questionnaires, SOC2/ISO requests, DPA questions, HIPAA intake). The classifier will tag request type, urgency, regulatory domain, and confidence, then route to the appropriate lane (auto-respond artifacts, Security, Legal, Solutions Engineering, or CSM escalation) with SLA targets and human-in-loop thresholds.
background: We receive ~50 security/compliance asks weekly. Manual triage creates high latency for enterprise deals and inconsistent prioritization. Current intake is a mix of email and Zendesk; we lack reliable routing based on regulatory domain and artifact type. Several high-touch deals experienced >10 day delays in SOC2 evidence delivery. This ticket proposes an ML-assisted triage layer plus explicit SLA lanes to reduce time-to-first-response and ensure consistent routing for regulated requests.
goals: Reduce median time-to-first-response on enterprise security requests from 72h to <=24h
Automatically classify and route >=85% of incoming requests correctly to the right team or automated artifact lane
Expose SLA lane and confidence in Console intake UI for triage transparency
Provide audit trail and metrics for prioritized enterprise requests
success_metrics: Median first-response time <=24 hours for classified requests
Reduction in manual routing volume by 40% after 8 weeks
Number of high-value deals with security-induced delays reduced by 50%
scope_in_scope: Design and implement classifier for request type (SOC2/ISO artifacts, DPA clause, inbound questionnaire, privacy/data residency ask)
Implement confidence thresholds that trigger human review for low-confidence items
Integrate routing actions into Zendesk/Intake inbox + Console routing dashboard
Expose per-request SLA lane and ETA in intake UI
scope_out_of_scope: Automated generation of legal contract text or signing DPAs
Full rewrite of Zendesk or replacement of helpdesk system
Building a complete questionnaire auto-responder for highly bespoke vendor RFIs
proposed_solution: Create a lightweight classifier pipeline that extracts signal from subject, body, attachment names, and metadata (customer tier, account id). The pipeline will output tags: request_type, regulatory_domain, artifact_requested, urgency, confidence_score. Routing rules will be a deterministic policy layer that combines tags with account tier and in-flight SLA usage to choose a lane: AUTO_ARTIFACT (pre-built artifacts), SECURITY_REVIEW, LEGAL_REVIEW, SOLUTION_SE, CSM_ESCALATION. Low-confidence outputs (confidence < 0.6) route to HUMAN_TRIAGE. Build a small admin UI for security/PMs to label training mistakes and push weekly model updates. Integrate observability into Console: per-lane queue depth, median handle time, misclassification rate.
classifier_spec: Features: email subject embeddings, body TF-IDF + transformer embeddings, attachment filename heuristics, keywords for regulations (SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA, GDPR, DPA), account metadata (ARR tier, region), historical response patterns. Model: lightweight transformer-based classifier (distilbert fine-tune or Logistic over embeddings for latency) with explainability hints (top tokens). Output schema: tags (strings), confidence (float as string), reason_snippet (string). Retraining cadence: weekly for first 6 weeks, then bi-weekly. Performance budget: inference latency <= 300ms per request, memory < 200MB for classifier service instance.
routing_rules: If artifact_requested in prepopulated_artifacts and confidence >= 0.75 -> AUTO_ARTIFACT lane (attach artifact + notify requester)
If regulatory_domain in {HIPAA, GDPR} and account_tier == Enterprise -> SECURITY_REVIEW lane (SLA 48h)
If request contains legal_terms or clause_negotiation flag -> LEGAL_REVIEW lane (SLA 72h)
If confidence < 0.6 -> HUMAN_TRIAGE lane assigned to PM/Eng rotation
If account flagged as 'deal_hot' or ARR > 500k -> CSM_ESCALATION priority lane (SLA 24h)
ui_changes: Intake inbox: show predicted tags and confidence with 'Confirm' / 'Escalate' quick actions
Console: new 'Security Intake' dashboard showing lanes, queue depth, MTTR, misclassification rate
Admin: labeler page to confirm/correct classifier outputs and export training samples
rollout_plan: Week 0-2: data collection and labeling (sample 400 historical requests)
Week 3: MVP classifier + deterministic rules + route to HUMAN_TRIAGE only (no auto-responses)
Week 4-5: shadow routing for AUTO_ARTIFACT and SECURITY lanes, measure precision/recall
Week 6: enable AUTO_ARTIFACT for high-confidence (>0.85) items; start weekly retraining
Week 8: full SLA-aware routing enabled; monitor and rollback policy if errors >5%
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: classifier misroutes sensitive legal asks -> Mitigation: conservative thresholds, human-in-loop for legal/regulatory signals
Risk: auto-responded artifacts contain stale evidence -> Mitigation: artifact versioning, require artifact freshness check before auto-attach
Risk: increased load on Security team due to false positives -> Mitigation: initial shadow mode and weekly feedback loops, throttle to 10/day
acceptance_criteria: MVP classifier deployed in shadow mode and evaluated on 400-sample holdout with >=80% routing accuracy
Intake UI shows predicted tags and allows triage actions; labels collected for 300 corrections
AUTO_ARTIFACT enabled only for items with confidence >=0.85 and auto-attach flow successfully sends artifacts in staging
Console dashboard surfaces per-lane SLA and queue metrics in real-time
